request: Verify Vault API config deploy, mount and health nonsecret only.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
n=libral-vault-libral-vault-1
sha=$(git -C /home/admin1/projects/libral-vault rev-parse HEAD)
status=$(docker inspect "$n" --format '{{.State.Status}}|{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}')
mount=$(docker inspect "$n" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/user/1000/astera-v8-tunnel-vault"}}{{.Type}}{{end}}{{end}}')
body=$(printf 'VAULT_TUNNEL_CONFIG_RUNTIME\nsha=%s\ncontainer=%s\nshared_mount=%s\n' "$sha" "$status" "$mount")
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'
